Reference / mime/media_type

mime/media_type#

Media types (RFC 2045, RFC 6838) and their parameters.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let type = MediaType("text/html; charset=utf-8");
type::Type::type;                                 // "text"
type::Type::subtype;                              // "html"
type.parameters().first("charset");               // "utf-8"
MediaType("text", "plain", MimeParameters([MimeParameter("charset", "utf-8")])).string();

Description#

Media types (RFC 2045, RFC 6838) and their parameters.

Type, subtype and parameter names are case-insensitive and kept lowercase.
